bagPolicy.summary: Small bags are allowed and are subject to search. Large bags are not allowed, including large backpacks, totes, large purses, duffle bags and suitcases.

parking.summary: Street parking in the surrounding neighborhood is first come, first served, and paid lots are available around The Fillmore. Don't park at Rivers Casino, since cars left there can be towed.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Barbary. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The door and the bar take cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover and AMEX, including tap to pay. Venmo, Cash App and PayPal are not accepted. Outside food, outside drinks and beverage containers of any kind are not allowed, though small items are OK at security's discretion.
prohibited: Outside food or beverages (small items OK at security's discretion)

accessibility.summary: The Barbary is ADA accessible. If you have questions or need anything arranged, contact the venue before you arrive.

reEntry.summary: The Barbary hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online ahead of the event while they're available, or at the door while supplies last. Bring a valid government-issued photo ID, such as a driver's license, state ID, US military photo ID or passport. Entry is always at staff discretion.

gates.summary: The Barbary hasn't published entrance and door time details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
